reuse.why: Introduces one shared ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked used for all five providers; no prior helper existed to reuse.

duplication.why: Five near-identical inline wrappers at method registration repeat the call and re-state each provider's sync-source literal and account-id extraction already encoded in the link functions.

placement.why: The guard is attached in the app.method registrations rather than inside the link functions that own the linking flow, so the handlers' own logic no longer tells the whole story and direct callers of linkXAccount skip it.

scope.why: Only the guard, its wiring and a focused test file are added.

maintainability.why: Provider strings in the wrappers must stay in sync with account_sync_source in each link function; the registration block becomes logic-bearing.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No existing abstraction is bypassed; the link functions themselves are wrapped rather than changed.

disguised_duplication.where: The wrappers repeat openly; nothing is reshaped to hide it.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked holds the rule; all five *-accounts-link registrations call it (each passing its own provider literal).
